Request 99-zone Central Unit status on dimension 14, what central_status() builds. Gateways refuse it: an F454 (MyHOME#629) and a real MyHomeServer1 3.1.8 (gdluck's gateway probe, OWNd#77) answer *#*0##. central_status() is deprecated for that reason (poll with status('#0'), see thermo.cmd.central.status.cu99), so this entry has no builder block. Kept only to record the refused frame; roundtrip means OWNd parses and re-serializes it exactly, not that a gateway accepts it

The judge warns that the WHAT is not standard: its WHO 4 catalog still has the 100..103 reading this replaced)
